week: WEEK OF 17-23 AUG 2026 - Build week 4. REVISION 16 AUG, THIRD PASS. Corporate Games Fri-Sun was not in the file; the week is rebuilt around it. THE BIG CHANGE: the full-format sim moves from Sat 22 Aug to WED 19 AUG, and goes to FULL RACE DISTANCE - built by extending Wednesday's 100% chain forwards with stations 1-4 rather than shrinking anything. All 8 stations at race weight, 8 x 1 km runs at 5:45-5:50 (compromise off 5:35). First time the two halves of the race have ever met in training. ~90 min of race work. WHAT IT COST: the exact-repeat-of-12-Aug lunge comparison is gone - the lunge now arrives with seven stations behind it, so a slower split is expected and there is no baseline to read it against. Accepted knowingly. LOAD: Mon ~85 + Wed ~160 + Fri ~50 + Sun ~30 = ~325, plus unscored softball. Roughly +4.5% on last week's 311, so the ramp problem the earlier drafts were wrestling with has gone away by itself. RUNNING ~33 km prescribed, up from ~28. The limiter still gets fed. HOLD TRIGGERS UNCHANGED and they outrank everything above: spinal symptom RPE >2 stops the session mid-station, ACWR >1.3, injury index >60, two consecutive nights under 6h, ankle stop rule. HEAT: if Wednesday is near 32C as 12 Aug was, stations 1-4 drop to half distance. 90+ min at 32C is a heat problem, not a training problem.

PACING: cap 250W for the first two minutes — cardiac lag is real, the 20 Jul file showed HR at 147 thirty seconds into rep 2 against a 165 steady state, taking ~150s to arrive. First km no faster than 5:40. Then HR-governed: 158-164 to min 5, 164-169 to min 10, 169-173 to min 20, 172-176 to min 27, empty the tank the last three minutes.

blocks.text: SAT 15 AUG. Sled access day. Sled push and pull remain sandbag friction-overloaded (since 3 Jul) — splits compare to 8 Aug and to each other, NOT to race benchmarks.

THE REVISED BIRMINGHAM MECHANISM — read this before you start. Race-file HR: Run 1 143.5 -> SkiErg 128.1 -> roxzone 120.8 -> Run 2 at 5:03/km, THE SAME PACE AS RUN 1, HR 150.8 -> Sled Push 5:14 of work against 2:59 at Cardiff -> every run after pinned 178-182. HR fell through the ski because SkiErg is upper-body and non-weight-bearing; it built a lactate cost the HR trace could not show. The ski loaded it. RUN 2 AT UNCHANGED PACE IS THE DECISION THAT SPENT IT. The sled push is where the time went.

REMOVED FROM THE 8 AUG BRIEF: 'can you hold run 1 pace straight off the ski'. That instruction rehearsed the failure. Run 2 is held at CONTROLLED pace regardless of how good the ski felt. That restraint is the skill being trained.

PEAK HR IS NOT THE METRIC. On 8 Aug the runs held 253-258W against CP 261 — 97-99% of threshold power — and still capped at HR 162, because a 3:00 block never lets HR arrive. Peak HR here measures block length, not effort.

SUCCESS CRITERIA, in order: (1) SLED PUSH SPLIT — the primary readout, the station that collapsed at Birmingham. (2) RESTART HR — HR at the top of run 4 no more than 6 bpm above the top of run 2. (3) FOUR RUN SPLITS INSIDE 5 SECONDS. (4) RATCHET SHAPE — you want climb-then-hold, roughly 155 -> 165 -> 170 -> 170. Climbing and still climbing at run 4 means you are rehearsing Birmingham. On 8 Aug it read 147 -> 158 -> 162 -> 162, which decelerated into a plateau at 162; the target band for a well-executed race is 168-174.
SKI: one notch harder than 8 Aug, not two. The 8 Aug PWA RPE was 7, not the 4 the old file recorded. Enough to leave a real cost, not enough to reproduce the failure.

RUN PACE: 5:25-5:35/km = 10.8-11.1 km/h, roughly 248-256W at CP 261. START RUN 1 AT 10.8. On 8 Aug you started at 10.98 and the two slowest runs followed — 16s spread across four when the stated test was four flat.
STATION EXPOSURE: 8 Aug logged SkiErg 3:10 / Sled Push 2:52 / Sled Pull 3:06 / BBJ 3:00 = 12:08. This week should read ~16:00. Log it — RSS scores station work at ~0W and cannot see these minutes.

blocks.text: WED 19 AUG @ RAW. THE SESSION YOU HAVE NEVER DONE. In seven weeks since 2 Jul the race has been trained as two halves that never meet - stations 1-4 in the sims, 5-8 in the chain. Birmingham's collapse started in the front half and propagated into the back. This tests the join, at full race distance.
MOVED FROM SAT 22 AUG - you are at the Corporate Games Fri-Sun. Built by extending Wednesday's 100% chain forwards rather than shrinking it, so stations 5-8 keep full race volume.

WHAT YOU GAVE UP TO GET THIS, so it is not a surprise afterwards: this is NOT a repeat of 12 Aug. The lunge arrives with SEVEN stations behind it instead of three, so a slower split than 6:39 is expected and correct, and there is no clean baseline to read it against. The 12 Aug comparison is gone until sharpen week. That was the trade.

RUN PACE 5:45-5:50/km, ALL EIGHT. Agreed compromise off 5:35. Runs controlled, stations attacked - the standing race rule. RUN 2 IS HELD AT RUN 1 PACE regardless of how the ski felt. That restraint is the skill being trained; holding pace off the ski at Birmingham is the decision that spent the race.

HEAT RULE. 12 Aug ran at 32C in an unventilated unit. 45 min at 32C is hard; 90+ min at 32C is a different category and is a heat problem, not a training problem. LOG THE TEMPERATURE BEFORE YOU START. If it is near 32C, drop stations 1-4 to HALF distance and keep 5-8 full. Do not attempt the full version in that heat.

SPINAL CHECKPOINTS on Sled Pull, Farmers Carry, Sandbag Lunge and Wall Balls - effort and symptom as SEPARATE numbers, logged immediately, free-texted because of the app floor defect. SYMPTOM RPE ABOVE 2 STOPS THE SESSION MID-STATION. Station 7 at full volume with seven stations behind it is the highest spinal exposure of the entire block - this is the single most likely place it shows up, and the rule does not soften because the session is interesting.
Sleds remain friction-overloaded (10 kg sandbag dragged in front, astroturf). Splits compare to 8 and 15 Aug, NOT to race benchmarks.

SUCCESS CRITERIA, in order: (1) completion without a symptom stop; (2) run 8 within 15 seconds of run 1; (3) where the HR trace plateaus - that number is your real race ceiling; (4) the full 1000m ski split, for calibration against the effort-6 700m extrapolation; (5) sled push split, the station that collapsed at Birmingham. blocks.text: LOG: all eight run splits, every station time, four spinal checkpoint pairs, the temperature at start, and total session time. Expect ~90 min of race work plus 20 min warm-up/cool-down.

THU 20 AUG. FULL REST - changed 16 Aug. The 35 min easy run that sat here is gone: a full-distance race sim is a race, and the day after one is not an easy-run day. Optional 15-20 min mobility, spine-neutral only, or a walk.
FRI 21 AUG. 48h after the sim, trimmed from 65 to 50 min for that reason. HR <=148. Cut to 30 min if Wednesday produced a symptom RPE above 2 at any checkpoint.

IF you can get out before travelling, run the SOUTH RIBBLE route - same loop as 12 Jul and 16 Aug. 12 Jul to 21 Aug is 40 days, close enough to call six weeks for the case study. Log temperature and humidity at the start. If you cannot, leave it for Sun 30 Aug rather than burning the comparison on unfamiliar ground.

SAT 22 AUG. Corporate Games. Softball, unscored - it will not appear in load figures and that is fine, but it is not nothing: rotational load under speed, throwing and batting. If anything flares, Sunday's optional run comes off.
OPEN LOOP: the clinician advised against the football. Whether softball was covered by that advice or only football was is not established. Same open question as the hinge-work one from 21 Jul.

SUN 23 AUG. Venue gym treadmill, 30-40 min easy, HR <=148. OPTIONAL - skip it without guilt if softball left you sore. Running is the limiter so it is worth taking if it is there, but a hotel treadmill run is not worth a niggle.
No station work at the venue gym - no sled or wall balls means anything station-shaped is a half-session that costs recovery and tests nothing.

Weekly planning session when you are back. TO SETTLE: (1) sharpen week w/c 24 Aug built around what, now the sim has moved to Wednesday 19th; (2) whether a second sim is needed at all before Tenerife; (3) whether the 148 easy cap is now conservative - wants a cool-morning uncapped run first, NOT a decision off a hot capped one. CLOSED, do not reopen: CTL target, locked 12 Aug at peak 39-41 by w/c 12 Oct.

prerun.text: PRE-RUN — ~9 min, in order. Spine-neutral throughout: no standing toe touches, no seated forward folds, no supine knees-to-chest. Press START on the first step, it auto-advances the whole routine.

prerun.label: Knee-to-wall dorsiflexion
prerun.detail: 10 reps/side, 2s hold at end range. Heel down, knee over 2nd toe. Switch at halfway. Note the L/R gap difference.

prerun.label: Ankle circles
prerun.detail: 20 each direction, both sides. Slow, full range.

prerun.label: Bent-knee heel raise
prerun.detail: 15 reps, 2s lower. Soleus — takes the running load, don't skip it.

prerun.label: Single-leg balance hold
prerun.detail: 20s on the weaker ankle only. Eyes open.

prerun.label: Half-kneeling hip flexor
prerun.detail: 30s/side. Squeeze the down-leg glute, tuck the pelvis. Do NOT arch the back to feel it.

prerun.label: 90/90 hip switches
prerun.detail: 8 slow reps. Sit tall, hands behind, chest up. Stop short if the low back rounds to get there.

prerun.label: Leg swings (wall support)
prerun.detail: 12 front/back then 12 lateral per side. Small range first 4, then build. Swing from the hip, trunk braced.

prerun.label: Glute bridge
prerun.detail: 15 reps, 2s squeeze at top, ribs down.

prerun.label: Banded lateral walk
prerun.detail: 10 steps each direction x2. Band above knees, soft knees, no torso lean.

prerun.label: Pogo hops
prerun.detail: 2 x 15. Stiff ankles, minimal knee bend, short ground contact. SKIP on easy days or if flat.
